<en id="wh392576">the</en> <en id="wh392577">fifth</en> <en id="wh392578">was Shephatiah</en>, <en id="wh392580">whose mother was Abital</en>;
<en id="wh392581">the</en> <en id="wh392582">sixth</en> <en id="wh392583">was Ithream</en>, whose mother <en id="wh392585">was Eglah</en>, <en id="wh392586">David’s wife</en>.

<en id="wh392594">where</en> <en id="wh392593">he ruled</en> <en id="wh392592">for</en> <en id="wh392595">seven</en> <en id="wh392596">years</en> <en id="wh392597">and</en> <en id="wh392598">six</en> <en id="wh392599">months</en>.
<en id="wh392605">He ruled</en> <en id="wh392601">thirty</en>-<en id="wh392603">three</en> <en id="wh392604">years</en> <en id="wh392606">in</en> <en id="wh392607">Jerusalem</en>.
<en id="wh392609">These</en> ... <en id="wh392611">to</en> <en id="wh392613">him in Jerusalem</en>:

<en id="wh392622">were the sons born</en> ... <en id="wh392614">Shimea</en>, <en id="wh392616">Shobab</en>, <en id="wh392618">Nathan</en>, <en id="wh392619">and</en> <en id="wh392620">Solomon</en> – <en id="wh392621">the mother of these four</en> <en id="wh392623">was Bathsheba</en> <en id="wh392624">the daughter</en> <en id="wh392625">of Ammiel</en>.
The other nine <en id="wh392627">were Ibhar</en>, <en id="wh392629">Elishua</en>, <en id="wh392631">Elpelet</en>,
<en id="wh392633">Nogah</en>, <en id="wh392635">Nepheg</en>, <en id="wh392637">Japhia</en>,
<en id="wh392639">Elishama</en>, <en id="wh392641">Eliada</en>, <en id="wh392642">and</en> <en id="wh392643">Eliphelet</en>.

<en id="wh392666">Joram</en> <en id="wh392667">his son</en>,
<en id="wh392668">Ahaziah</en> <en id="wh392669">his son</en>,
<en id="wh392670">Joash</en> <en id="wh392671">his son</en>,

<en id="wh392674">Azariah</en> <en id="wh392675">his son</en>,
<en id="wh392676">Jotham</en> <en id="wh392677">his son</en>,
<en id="wh392678">Ahaz</en> <en id="wh392679">his son</en>,
<en id="wh392680">Hezekiah</en> <en id="wh392681">his son</en>,

<en id="wh392686">Josiah</en> <en id="wh392687">his son</en>.
<en id="wh392689">sons</en> <en id="wh392690">of Josiah</en>:

<en id="wh392879">Naarah</en> <en id="wh392877">bore</en> <en id="wh392881">him Ahuzzam</en>, <en id="wh392884">Hepher</en>, <en id="wh392887">Temeni</en>, <en id="wh392888">and</en> <en id="wh392891">Haahashtari</en>.
<en id="wh392892">These</en> <en id="wh392893">were the sons</en> <en id="wh392894">of Naarah</en>.
<en id="wh392896">The sons</en> <en id="wh392897">of Helah</en>: <en id="wh392898">Zereth</en>, <en id="wh392900">Zohar</en>, <en id="wh392902">Ethnan</en>,

<en id="wh392903">and</en> <en id="wh392904">Koz</en>, <en id="wh392905">who was the father of</en> <en id="wh392907">Anub</en>, <en id="wh392910">Hazzobebah</en>, <en id="wh392911">and</en> <en id="wh392912">the clans</en> <en id="wh392913">of Aharhel</en> <en id="wh392914">the son</en> <en id="wh392915">of Harum</en>.

<en id="wh392928">for she said</en>, ... <en id="wh392927">to</en>

<en id="wh392935">Jabez</en> <en id="wh392934">called out</en> <en id="wh392936">to</en> <en id="wh392937">the God</en> <en id="wh392938">of Israel</en>,

<en id="wh392950">May your hand</en> <en id="wh392949">be</en> <en id="wh392951">with</en>
<en id="wh392953">me! Keep</en> <en id="wh392955">me</en> <en id="wh392954">from</en> <en id="wh392955">harm</en>
<en id="wh392957">so</en> ... might not <en id="wh392958">endure pain</en>!”
<en id="wh392961">God</en> <en id="wh392959">answered</en>
<en id="wh392963">his prayer</en>.

<en id="wh392965">I</en> [v11] <en id="wh392966">Kelub</en>, <en id="wh392967">the brother</en> <en id="wh392968">of Shuhah</en>, <en id="wh392969">was the father of</en> <en id="wh392971">Mehir</en>,
<en id="wh392972">who</en> <en id="wh392973">was the father</en> <en id="wh392974">of Eshton</en>.

<en id="wh393206">But</en> <en id="wh393208">his brothers</en> ... <en id="wh393211">have many</en> ... <en id="wh393209">was not</en> ... <en id="wh393207">as</en> <en id="wh393210">the sons</en>
